# Resultapp.org

> The all-in-one result compilation platform for Nigerian schools — automated
> grading, digital report cards, custom school portals, and pay-per-student billing.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://resultapp.org/): Product overview, features, and pricing calculator.
- [Pricing](https://resultapp.org/pricing): Pay-per-student credit pricing (₦100/₦90/₦80 tiers).
- [Register](https://resultapp.org/register): Create a school portal at `yourschool.resultapp.org`.
- [About](https://resultapp.org/about): Mission and values.
- [Contact](https://resultapp.org/contact): WhatsApp and email support (8am–8pm WAT).
- [Support](https://resultapp.org/support): Bug reports and feedback.

## Tenant portals

Each school gets a subdomain portal (`{school}.resultapp.org`) with a public
result checker, staff grading workspace, admin dashboard (allocations,
templates, settings, billing), and printable student report cards.

## Contact
